value_inflection_events.event: Merger Agreement executed and publicly announced

leaked_early.details: Based on search of historical financial news, no pre-deal rumors or specific takeover speculation were reported for Noven prior to the July 14, 2009 announcement.

notes: Deal was a cash tender offer by Hisamitsu for $16.50/share. The Board prioritized deal certainty over a potential price bump following positive Phase 2 data for Mesafem. Shares rallied significantly pre-announcement in June/July 2009, possibly suggesting speculation or leak.
